map.由两组样本量方差求合并方差: Pooled Variance from Two Sample Variances
map.输入两组样本量 n₁、n₂ 与方差 s₁²、s₂²，求合并方差。: Enter the two sample sizes n₁ and n₂ together with the variances s₁² and s₂² to get the pooled variance.
map.📖 查看「由两组样本量方差求合并方差使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pooled Variance from Two Sample Variances User Guide"
map.两样本 t 检验假定等方差时使用。: Used when the two-sample t-test assumes equal variances.
map.两样本 t 检验的共同方差估计。: A common variance estimate for the two-sample t-test.
map.假设方差齐时更精确。: More precise when the variances are assumed equal.
map.合并方差为何加权平均？: Why is the pooled variance a weighted average?
map.用自由度（n−1）加权，样本多的组方差权重更大，是无偏合并。: It is weighted by degrees of freedom (n−1), so the larger sample carries more weight; this gives an unbiased pooling.
map.方差不齐还能合并？: Can unequal variances still be pooled?
map.不宜，应直接用 Welch t（不合并、df 校正）。: No. Use Welch's t-test directly, which does not pool variances and corrects the degrees of freedom.
